note: Verify pass 2026-09-11. passcheck had only one Wikidata lead (an Anne Frank sapling, not chased) and no register. Found the naming body: City of Pittsburgh Shade Tree Commission's 'Remarkable Trees of Pittsburgh' program (partnership with Tree Pittsburgh), confirmed via official meeting minutes (a real government PDF). remarkabletreespgh.com itself, which almost certainly has the full designated list with better detail and photos, is JavaScript-rendered and returned nothing to plain curl or WebFetch this pass; a browser-rendering pass should retry it directly and would likely upgrade all four delivered trees plus surface more. 4 trees delivered (pit_001-004), reaching the 4-tree floor. Pass 2026-10-22: the program's Google My Map KML gave 16 tree points; 12 new trees delivered to data/research/pittsburgh-verified.json (pit_005-016) from Shade Tree Commission minutes 2023-03-16 and 2024-03-21 plus the map coordinates. All one-source (government minutes), no girth or age published anywhere.

leads.name: Pin upgrade for pit_001 to pit_004 (Mellon Park cypress, katsura, lacebark pine, Phillips Park white oak)
leads.why: The Remarkable Trees map has tree-level points: Mellon bald cypress 40.45177,-79.91696; katsura 40.4522,-79.91681; lacebark pine 40.45465,-79.9145; Phillips Park white oak 40.39147,-79.9917 (current pins 40.4535,-79.9168 / 40.4548,-79.9168 / 40.3906,-79.9916). Cypress and katsura are about 100 m from the current pin and the lacebark pine is 190 m off. Official tree-level evidence for pin_source; apply as a pin move.

leads.name: Frick Park elm (Tree of a Kind, waiting on Champion measurements, 2023 minutes)
leads.why: Not on the map and not in the 2024 designations; no point or update found. The 2024 Champion elm is in Allegheny Commons (pit_011), a different tree.

leads.name: Anne Frank's Tree at the Community Day School (Wikidata Q140073093)
leads.why: School grounds: hard rule 10 needs evidence the grounds are open. Not chased.

leads.name: Remarkable Trees 2024 classes not on the map: nothing unmatched
leads.why: All 16 map points are matched: 4 already live (pit_001-004), 12 delivered (pit_005-016). 2024 minutes tabled 3 nominations and rejected 5; names not published. The 2025 class, if any, is not on the 2024 map; check remarkabletreespgh.com for a 2025 page.

leads.name: The Sycamore of Hazelwood Greenway
leads.why: Remarkable Trees 2024 Tree of a Kind (minutes 2024-03-21). Back to leads 2026-10-22: approximate pin in greenway woodland with other sycamores, no size published, path to the tree unverified and no recent observation near the point, so no honest recognition line. Ships with a photo, a GPS fix or a measurement. Source: https://www.pittsburghpa.gov/files/assets/city/v/1/bac/documents/stc/24845_stc_meeting_minutes_march_2024.pdf (Shade Tree Commission minutes 2024-03-21: Tree of a Kind, American Sycamore, Hazelwood Greenway)

leads.why: Remarkable Trees 2024 Witness Tree (minutes 2024-03-21: 'Oak, West End Park'; pin oak per the program map only). Back to leads 2026-10-22: approximate pin, no size, and its history (the minutes' remark about KDKA's opening branding) has no second source, so neither a story nor a recognition line can be written honestly. Ships with a second source for the KDKA connection plus a photo or GPS fix. Source: https://www.pittsburghpa.gov/files/assets/city/v/1/bac/documents/stc/24845_stc_meeting_minutes_march_2024.pdf (Shade Tree Commission minutes 2024-03-21: Witness Tree, Oak, West End Park; commissioners note the tree is part of KDKA's opening branding)
